[EN] [Solo] Olivung's Intermediate Cooking Class
[ES] [Solo] Clase de cocina intermedia de Olivung
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll help."
[ES] "Te ayudaré".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find Olivung on the Island of Dawn.
[ES] Busca a Olivung en la Isla del Amanecer.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Fimbrilisk's Durignite
[ES] Durignita de Fimbrilisk
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Obtain a Cruel Fimbrilisk's Durignite and deliver it to Olivung.
[ES] Consigue la durignita de un Fimbrilisk cruel y entrégasela a Olivung.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Taste the Magma Ice Cream.
[ES] Prueba el helado de magma.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Taste the Magma Ice Cream. [Press key to open your inventory, and select the Magma Ice Cream.]
[ES] Prueba el helado de magma. [Presiona la tecla para abrir tu inventario y selecciona el helado de magma.]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Obtain the second piece of the Aspiration Stone.
[ES] Consigue la segunda pieza de la Piedra de la Aspiración.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Olivung at the Southern Checkpoint.
[ES] Habla con Olivung en el Puesto de control sur.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Use the second piece of the Aspiration Stone to empower the Eternal Crown. [Press key to open your inventory, and select the Aspiration Stone - Second Piece.]
[ES] Usa la segunda pieza de la Piedra de la Aspiración para potenciar la Corona Eterna. [Presiona la tecla para abrir tu inventario y selecciona la Piedra de la Aspiración (segunda pieza).]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Claim reward.
[ES] Reclama la recompensa.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Olivung at the Southern Checkpoint.
[ES] Habla con Olivung en el Puesto de control sur.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
